dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: There are many societies in the Akademiya, but no Light Novel Society. It's strange, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: Light novels don't seem popular in Sumeru, but it is the Nation of Wisdom after all. There shouldn't be any gaps in our fields of knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: I am not exactly a researcher of the Akademiya, but I am second to none when it comes to light novels.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: Should we have an initiation ceremony or something like that?
